Update should include: 1)Tag assigner and reviewers 2)If ASAP trigger word is present in pull request message - notify assigner via personal message. 3)Link pull request in a group if there are any other pull requests with the same issue number. In this case there should not be a new message sent but previous updated. See message template in readme.
